items.description:
Codfather Seafood & Sushi is a restaurant in Camps Bay, Cape Town, serving an extensive menu of fresh fish, shellfish and innovative sushi. The range includes prawns, oysters, langoustines and crayfish, alongside tender Falkland's calamari and a wide variety of fresh linefish, chosen for freshness, quality and variety.

For a quieter and more intimate meal, guests can dine in the restaurant's exclusive Wine Cellar, surrounded by thousands of bottles of wine. The restaurant describes itself as one of the most reviewed restaurants on TripAdvisor, reflecting its standing among visitors to Camps Bay. Guests can book a table online ahead of their visit. It suits diners who want a wide seafood and sushi selection with the option of a more private wine cellar setting.

Coronation Bazaar is a long-running general store at the crossroads of Coronation and Melbourne Roads in Walmer Estate, Cape Town, trading from a baby-blue building dated 1935. A VoiceMap audio tour of the neighbourhood stops at the shop and notes that, since there are no major shopping malls or retail outlets nearby, corner cafes like this one are common in Walmer Estate.

The tour explains that most of the area's shop owners have lived and operated their businesses here for more than 50 years, with many originally coming from District Six before it was declared a white-only area in the 1960s. Coronation Bazaar is part of that same community history, trading through decades of change in the neighbourhood. It suits visitors interested in the area's history as much as locals doing everyday shopping.

items.description:
Deon Stuart Electronics and Installations is a security and installations business at 4 Ventura Street in Rocklands, Mitchells Plain, with 25 years of experience in the field. The business offers alarm systems, CCTV surveillance, garage and gate automation and related electronic security installations.

Its directory listing shows the business trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:30, closed on weekends. Customers can contact the business by phone or send an email enquiry through its listing. It suits homeowners and businesses in Rocklands and Mitchells Plain who want an experienced local installer for alarms, CCTV or automated gates. The listing lets customers write a review or report incorrect details directly on the page.

Department of Coffee is a coffee shop on Ntlazane Street in Khayelitsha, Cape Town, described in a Cape Town Etc feature as the Mother City's only official township coffee shop. The article notes that visitors can get the same rich quality coffee they might expect elsewhere, but in a completely different setting from the usual cafe.

The feature describes how tourists visit the shop to get a sense of the black community of Khayelitsha while enjoying their coffee exactly the way they like it, something the writer says had the whole city of Cape Town gasping in surprise when the shop first opened. It suits visitors and locals who want good coffee along with a genuine taste of life in Khayelitsha.

items.description:
El Burro is a Mexican tapas-style restaurant at 79 Main Road in Green Point, Cape Town, serving dishes inspired by the owners' travels across Mexico. The menu is prepared fresh daily, with hand-pressed corn tortillas, fresh salsas and freshly squeezed lime juice used for its margaritas.

The Green Point branch trades Monday to Saturday from midday to 23:30 and Sundays from midday to 21:00, and it does not take reservations. El Burro also has a sister branch on Kloof Nek in Tamboerskloof, and the brand sells Cabrito and Centinela tequila at retail. It suits diners who want casual Mexican food and margaritas without needing to book ahead.

Epping Property is an industrial property brokerage based in Thornton, Cape Town, specialising in the Epping Industria area. Its site describes Epping Industria as one of Cape Town's most established and strategically important industrial areas, playing a central role in the city's manufacturing, warehousing and logistics sector for more than 70 years.

The agency publishes guides for business owners looking to buy or rent industrial space, noting that Cape Town's industrial property market is undergoing a major transformation as demand for the right type of space continues to grow. It helps clients navigate a market where finding the right building, in the right location, at the right price can be difficult. It suits businesses looking to buy or rent factory, warehouse or industrial premises in the Epping area.

items.description:
Golden Arrow Bus Services, commonly known as Golden Arrow or GABS, is a public transport bus operator headquartered at 103 Bofors Circle in Epping, Cape Town. Founded in 1861, the company is one of two major public transport bus operators in the city and is owned via Frontier Transport Holdings, part of Hosken Consolidated Investments.

The company runs around 1,300 routes with a fleet of about 1,300 buses, including both diesel and electric vehicles, serving around seven hubs across the metro. Its daily ridership is about 230,000 passengers, making it one of the city's most heavily used transport services. It suits commuters across Cape Town who rely on Golden Arrow's extensive bus network for daily travel.

items.description:
Kristen's Kick-Ass Ice Cream is an ice-cream shop in Noordhoek Farm Village, Cape Town, making its product by hand in small batches using local dairy and sustainable ingredients sourced in South Africa. All flavours are made from scratch in the kitchen above the shop, where nuts are toasted, fruits are roasted and caramel is swirled by hand.

The shop also bakes its own 'Oreos' for the Cookies & Cream flavour, and guests can order scoops, takeaway tubs, waffles or cookies. It is open daily from 9am to 5pm. It suits families and visitors to the Farm Village who want handmade ice cream using quality local ingredients.

items.description:
Malok is a homegrown South African clothing brand based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town. The brand describes itself as honest and homegrown, creating beautiful, classic, feminine and versatile pieces without compromising on comfort, using simple lines and contemporary designs.

Its garments are made from natural fabrics chosen to be easier on the environment and friendlier on the skin, and every piece is ethically designed and produced in the brand's own studio and boutique at the Old Biscuit Mill. Malok has also opened a sister shop called Malok Lifestyle, where it curates products from a group of talented local creatives. It suits shoppers who want locally made, sustainably produced womenswear from a Cape Town brand.

Mango Ginger is a coffee shop and bakery in Observatory, Cape Town, open since 2006 and known for delicious, nutritious, homemade food. It is open for breakfast and lunch, with fresh bakery counters, wholesome plates, coffee and prepared meals customers can take home.

Signature dishes on its menu include a Vegan Bounty Bowl, a gluten-free and sugar-free coconut lemon cheesecake finished with berry brightness, eggs Benedict with poached eggs and warm hollandaise, and a matcha latte. The cafe specialises in gluten-free, sugar-free and vegan options alongside its regular menu, and it also offers catering. It suits health-conscious diners in Observatory who want a wholesome breakfast or lunch with gluten-free and vegan choices.

Marble is a fire-cooking restaurant on the top floor of the historic Union Castle Building at the V&A Waterfront, created by a chef whose original Johannesburg restaurant has been a celebration of fire cooking, carefully sourced meat and classic South African flavours since it opened in 2016. The Cape Town branch, developed with a business partner, reimagines the historic building with wrap-around rooftop glass-walled views of Table Mountain, the working harbour and the Atlantic Ocean.

The restaurant continues the signature Marble style, with the chef adding a touch of Cape Town to the concept. It offers a real destination feel, built around the experience and vibe of the space as much as the food itself. It suits diners who want fire-cooked dishes paired with some of the best views at the Waterfront.

Martins Bakery is a bakery, deli and coffee shop at 43 Main Road in Diep River, Cape Town, established by Firmino Martins in 1970 as a local convenience store then known as Steurhof Cafe. His successor John Martins followed in his father's footsteps and opened the bakery division in 1983, after leaving his job as a bank manager to follow his passion, and he now runs it with his wife.

The European-style bakery offers healthy and homemade goods, including gluten-free, wheat-free, sugar-free and banting products, alongside farm-style breakfasts and lunches and a large selection of cakes. It bakes non-commercial, homemade breads with no preservatives, using traditional techniques such as sourdough. It suits health-conscious customers in the southern suburbs who want fresh baking and a relaxed deli menu.

items.description:
Montague Gardens Hardware and Steel is a hardware and steel fabrication business at 20 Montague Drive in Montague Gardens, Cape Town, founded in 1976. It began as a modest woodworking workshop and has expanded over the decades into steel fabrication, becoming the business known today.

The company sits in Cape Town's Montague Gardens industrial precinct, prized for its location near the N1 and N7 highways and its proximity to Cape Town International Airport, surrounded by other established businesses and distribution hubs. Its range covers hardware and DIY essentials, including tools, galvanised pipe fittings, stainless-steel bolts and nuts, safety gear, drill bits and garden kits. It suits tradespeople and DIY customers who need hardware supplies alongside custom steel fabrication work.

items.description:
Parow Family Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on the corner of Jan van Riebeeck and Voortrekker Road in Parow, Cape Town, that opened to the public on 27 November 2002. The pharmacy offers extended hours, free deliveries and a trusted community focus, aiming to make its customers' health journey more accessible and personal.

Its pharmacist describes travelling regularly to pharmaceutical congresses to stay current with new treatments and best practice, and says that operating a good pharmacy depends on a dedicated team of pharmacists, assistants, nurses and staff who share a passion for helping people. The pharmacy says a healthy community is a happy one, and it sees helping customers stay healthy as its most important mission. It suits residents of Parow who want personal, community-focused pharmacy care.

Partners Hair Design is a hair salon at Shop 66, Gardens Centre, on Mill Street in Gardens, Cape Town. It serves clients from Gardens, Oranjezicht, Tamboerskloof, De Waal Park and the wider City Bowl, with a team of professionally trained stylists.

Services cover the full range of hair work, from precision haircuts and colour treatments to keratin smoothing, scalp treatments and specialist curl services. Walk-ins are welcome for cuts and blow-dries, while colour and treatments are best booked ahead. The salon trades from 9am to 6pm. It suits anyone in the City Bowl who wants precision cuts, colour or specialist curl care close to Gardens Centre.

items.description:
Pho Thy is a halal-certified Vietnamese restaurant on Kenilworth's Main Road, in a cosy and unfussy setting. Its name is pronounced Faa-Thee, and it is the sister restaurant of Pho & Bun in Diep River, with a very similar menu of pho, the brothy, fresh Vietnamese soup served in chicken or beef versions.

The restaurant serves authentic Vietnamese dishes with fresh ingredients, and it trades from 10:00 to 21:00, Monday to Saturday. Its price range is listed as cheap to medium, from under R100 to around R300 per person. It suits diners looking for an affordable, authentic bowl of pho or other Vietnamese dishes in Kenilworth.
